Hill estimator across k values

Source: R/threshold-selection.R
hill_estimates.Rd

Computes the Hill estimator for heavy-tail index over a range of order statistics counts `k`.

Usage

hill_estimates(x, k_values)

Arguments

x

Numeric vector of observations (positive values).

k_values

Integer vector specifying number of top order statistics.

Value

Data frame with columns `k` and `hill` containing the estimates. Values of `k` greater than `length(x) - 1` are ignored.

References

Hill, B. M. (1975). A simple general approach to inference about the tail of a distribution. The Annals of Statistics, 3(5), 1163-1174.

Examples

hill_estimates(rexp(1000), 1:50)
